verdict.rationale: Plaid is a fintech API and dashboard platform, so in-product AI insights are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the product. The Dashboard MCP server exposes diagnostics and analytics tools to external agents, which is a separate MCP-server capability and not in-product AI insight generation, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
